children.role_hint: Main clocked dynamic comparator core containing the differential input pair, clocked tail device, precharge devices, and regenerative cross-coupled latch nodes. No diode-connected bias generator is present; operation is controlled dynamically by clk and the supplies.
children.role_description: Main clocked dynamic comparator core containing the differential input pair, clocked tail device, precharge devices, and regenerative cross-coupled latch nodes. No diode-connected bias generator is present; operation is controlled dynamically by clk and the supplies.
children.netlist:
.subckt clocked_dynamic_comparator_core vss vdd Vin Vip clk VP VQ Vx Vy
MN2 VQ Vin net17 vss nmos w=W2 l=L2 nf=1 m=1
MN4 Vx Vy VP vss nmos w=W3 l=L3 nf=1 m=1
MN1 net17 clk vss vss nmos w=W l=L1 nf=1 m=1
MN3 Vy Vx VQ vss nmos w=W3 l=L3 nf=1 m=1
MN0 VP Vip net17 vss nmos w=W2 l=L2 nf=1 m=1
MN10 VP clk vdd vdd pmos w=W6 l=L6 nf=1 m=1
MN8 Vy clk vdd vdd pmos w=W5 l=L5 nf=1 m=1
MN6 Vx Vy vdd vdd pmos w=W4 l=L4 nf=1 m=1
MN5 Vy Vx vdd vdd pmos w=W4 l=L4 nf=1 m=1
MN7 Vx clk vdd vdd pmos w=W5 l=L5 nf=1 m=1
MN9 VQ clk vdd vdd pmos w=W6 l=L6 nf=1 m=1
.ends clocked_dynamic_comparator_core

children.role_hint: Capacitive loading and dynamic storage network on the internal comparator latch and intermediate nodes.
children.role_description: Capacitive loading and dynamic storage network on the internal comparator latch and intermediate nodes.
children.netlist:

C3 Vy vss cap C3
C2 Vx vss cap C2
C0 VP vss cap C0
C1 VQ vss cap C1
.ends dynamic_node_capacitive_load_network

children.role_hint: CMOS inverter-style output gain/buffer stage driven by internal latch node Vy and producing the top-level output Von.

M16 Von Vy vdd vdd pmos w=120n l=60n nf=1 m=1
